Online.BadAddress: Type the website address, like https://pos-reports.yourshop.workers.dev
Online.Enabled: Send reports to the website (every 5 minutes, from whichever till is on)
Online.ExistingHint: The upload key is the UPLOAD_KEY secret given to the website when it was published.
Online.Intro: See this shop's sales, profit, drawers and stock on any phone or computer, from anywhere, even when this PC is off. Free, on the shop's own Cloudflare account. Managers and admins sign in with their POS username and password.
Online.KeyRequired: Type the upload key (at least 16 characters).
Online.Link: Website link (open it on your phone and add it to the home screen)
Online.LoadFailed: Couldn't load the online reports settings.
Online.NeedsLicense: Online reports work on licensed shops. Activate the license to use them.
Online.PasswordHint: The website can be opened from anywhere, so give these accounts strong passwords: at least 8 characters, not easy to guess.
Online.Permissions:
Account · Workers Scripts · Edit
Account · D1 · Edit
Account · Account Settings · Read
Online.RememberToken: Remember the token on this PC (encrypted), so the website updates itself after POS updates
Online.RemoveConfirm: Stop sending reports and forget this website? The website stays on your Cloudflare account until you delete it there.
Online.SetUpHint: Takes about 5 minutes: create a free Cloudflare account, make an API token and paste it. The POS does the rest.
Online.SetupIntro: The website runs on the shop's own free Cloudflare account, so the shop's reports stay in the shop's account. Do this once, from any till.
Online.SignOutAllConfirm: Sign out every phone and computer from the reports website? Everyone will need to sign in again with their username and password.
Online.SiteNoAnswer: {0} doesn't answer as a reports website. Check the address and the internet connection.
Online.SiteNotYet: The website is set up at {0}. A new address can take a few minutes to start working; the reports are sent as soon as it answers.
Online.SiteOtherVersion: This website is a different version ({0}) from what this POS sends. Publish the website from this POS's cloud/reports-worker.
Online.StatusOff: Off: nothing is sent. The website keeps showing the last reports it received.
Online.StatusOffline: Can't reach the website since {0}. No internet? It sends again by itself when the connection is back.
Online.StatusOutdated: The website is older than this POS and needs updating. Use "Update website".
Online.StatusRejected: The website refused this shop's upload key. Use "Set up again".
Online.StatusServer: The website answered with an error since {0}: {1}
Online.StatusWaiting: Nothing sent yet. The first upload starts within 5 minutes, or press "Upload now".
Online.Step.wait: Waiting for the website to answer (up to a minute)…

Online.WhoCanSignIn: Who can sign in: active managers and admins, with their POS username and password. Cashiers can't. A password change or a deactivated account takes effect on the website within 5 minutes. 5 wrong passwords lock that account on the website for 15 minutes.
